text: REJECT: the behaviour looks preserved, but the extraction leaves `RunTurnAsync` with many nested ifs, ternaries and `&&`/`||` chains inside the try block (the `Broken`, `Unjudged`, `wouldLand`, `!dryRun` and `why` branches alone add about 19), which very likely still exceeds 15. The new helper signatures also use type names (`Dropped`, `OwedWrite`) that the diff doesn't confirm exist, so the warnings-as-errors build is unverified.
